author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Discovers bounded Twitch clips and publishes each stable clip once to a Discord channel or forum.
changelog: 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial safe-baseline release with stable clip deduplication, bounded polling, channel/forum delivery, and private webhook isolation.

manifest.name: Clip Courier
installationSteps: Import the Clip Courier Streamer.bot package.
Put a private Discord webhook in its Deliver action and leave both actions triggerless.
Approve Get Clips and Deliver, configure the destination, then enable the add-on.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its bounded publication history remains preserved.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded Twitch discovery and idempotent Discord publication are available.
